        CASE
            WHEN mv.volume = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM parsed p
    JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.homefirm = p.homefirm
     AND mv.start_month = p.start_month
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = p.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE p.homefirm = 'COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS US CORP'
      AND p.start_month = '2023-12'
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        i.filekey,
        i.headct,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS specificity
    FROM case_inputs i
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = i.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = i.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = i.h1b_dependent)

)
SELECT round(
    sum(coalesce(base_hours, 3.50) + coalesce(position_hours, 0.50) * headct),

WHERE rn = 1;

WITH dec_cases AS (
    SELECT c.filekey,
           c.homefirm,
           c.headct,
           c.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
           c.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
           substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
           cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
           pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2023-12-01'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
firm_counts AS (
    SELECT homefirm, COUNT(DISTINCT filekey) AS case_count
    FROM dec_cases
    GROUP BY homefirm
),
classified AS (
    SELECT d.*,

           CASE
               WHEN f.case_count = 1 THEN '1'

               WHEN f.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
               ELSE '15+'

),

    FROM classified c
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule r

    c.h1bDep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
    substr(c.socCd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
    cw.wsState AS worksite_state,
    CASE
      WHEN m.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN m.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN m.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      WHEN m.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
    END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM cases c
  JOIN monthly m
    ON m.homeFirm = c.homeFirm
   AND m.start_month = date_trunc('month', try_strptime(c.beginDay, '%d/%m/%Y'))
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockKey = c.fileKey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackNo = cw.wageTrack
  WHERE c.homeFirm = 'COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS US CORP'
    AND date_trunc('month', try_strptime(c.beginDay, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2023-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ci.fileKey,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ci.fileKey
      ORDER BY
        (
          (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INT +
          (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INT +
          (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INT +
          (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INT +
          (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INT +
          (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INT
        ) DESC,
        r.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM case_inputs ci
  JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ci.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ci.wage_level)

),

  LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.fileKey = ci.fileKey AND r.rn = 1
)
SELECT round(sum(crh), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM per_case;

WITH case_wage AS (
  SELECT

    CAST(
      replace(replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'), '$', ''), ',', '')
      AS DOUBLE
    ) * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
          WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
          WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
          WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS aow,
    CAST(
      replace(replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'), 'USD ', ''), ',', '')
      AS DOUBLE
    ) * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
          WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
          WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
          WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
          WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
  FROM cases AS c

  JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'WIPRO LIMITED'

    AND strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'
),

    ) + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
          WHEN 'I' THEN 25
          WHEN 'II' THEN 50
          WHEN 'III' THEN 75
          WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
          ELSE 50
        END AS cwas
  FROM case_wage
```sql
)
```

    )::DOUBLE AS offered_amount,

      ',', '', 'g'
    )::DOUBLE AS prevailing_amount,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit') AS offered_unit,

WITH parsed_cases AS (

    FROM cases c

    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT homefirm, start_month, count(*) AS emcv
    FROM parsed_cases
    WHERE start_month IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY homefirm, start_month
),
cases_with_band AS (
    SELECT
        pc.*,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN mv.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM parsed_cases pc
    JOIN monthly_volume mv USING (homefirm, start_month)
),
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM cases_with_band c
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = c.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = c.wage_level)

```sql
)
```

           WHEN m.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
         END AS monthly_volume_band,
         cw.wsstate,
         json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
  FROM parsed p
  JOIN monthly_volume m
    ON m.homefirm = p.homefirm
   AND m.start_month = date_trunc('month', p.start_date)
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw
    ON cw.dockkey = p.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw
    ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE p.start_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2024-02-01'
),
ranked AS (

WITH december_cases AS (

    WHERE try_strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2023-12-01'

        CAST(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'), '[ $,]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE)
            * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
              END AS aow,
        CAST(regexp_replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'), '[USD $,]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE)
            * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
              END AS apw,

Using the review schedule as the score—matching all non-NULL rule criteria, selecting the most specific match, and assigning zero when none matches—the average is **3.58**.

```sql
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        substr(recvday, 1, 7) AS recv_month,
        COUNT(*) AS case_count
    FROM cases
    GROUP BY homefirm, substr(recvday, 1, 7)
),
target_cases AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.visacls,
        c.h1bdep,
        substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        c.headct,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        CASE
            WHEN m.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN m.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN m.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM cases c
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    LEFT JOIN monthly m
        ON m.homefirm = c.homefirm
       AND m.recv_month = substr(c.recvday, 1, 7)
    WHERE c.soccd LIKE '13%'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginDay, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginDay, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        t.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours + r.position_hours * t.headct AS score,
        (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INT AS specificity
    FROM target_cases t
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = t.visacls)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = t.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = t.h1bdep)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = t.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = t.worksite_state)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = t.monthly_volume_band)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY filekey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM candidates
),
case_scores AS (
    SELECT
        t.filekey,
        COALESCE(r.score, 0) AS score
    FROM target_cases t
    LEFT JOIN ranked r
      ON r.filekey = t.filekey
     AND r.rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS average_score
FROM case_scores;
```

answer:
The schema does not define a Wage Assurance Score formula or tier thresholds. Using an explicit interpretation—average offered wage as a percentage of prevailing wage, with scores of at least 100% classified as “Above prevailing”—Google LLC’s June 2024 score is **118.78**, in the **Above prevailing** tier.

```sql
WITH june_cases AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'),
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS offered_wage,
        TRY_CAST(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing_wage
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Google LLC'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-06-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-07-01'
),
score AS (
    SELECT AVG(offered_wage / prevailing_wage * 100) AS value
    FROM june_cases
    WHERE offered_wage IS NOT NULL
      AND prevailing_wage IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN value >= 100 THEN 'Above prevailing'
        ELSE 'At or below prevailing'
    END AS tier_name,
    ROUND(value, 2) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM score;
```

The schema does not define a “Case Wage Assurance Score.” Assuming it means the offered minimum wage divided by the prevailing wage, expressed as a percentage, this query averages worksite scores within each case, then averages those case-level scores by dependency status.

```sql
WITH worksite_scores AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.h1bdep,
        100.0
            * TRY_CAST(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(pw.wage_details ->> '$.offered_wage.from', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')
                AS DOUBLE
              )
            / NULLIF(
                TRY_CAST(
                    REGEXP_REPLACE(pw.wage_details ->> '$.prevailing_wage.value', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')
                    AS DOUBLE
                ),
                0
              ) AS score
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') <  DATE '2024-02-01'
      AND c.h1bdep IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
case_scores AS (
    SELECT filekey, h1bdep, AVG(score) AS case_score
    FROM worksite_scores
    GROUP BY filekey, h1bdep
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(case_score) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS average_yes,
    ROUND(AVG(case_score) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS average_no
FROM case_scores;
```

```sql
        ) AS cmrc
```

```sql
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
),
```
```sql
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        (
            CASE WHEN rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN rr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE
                WHEN rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                  OR rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
              END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM return_base b
    JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (

         OR rr.item_condition = json_extract_string(
             b.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition'
         )
     )
     AND (
         rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL

     )
     AND (
         rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
         OR b.cmrc <= rr.max_monthly_returns
     )
```

        rr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
```sql
            PARTITION BY b.casenum
            ORDER BY
```
```sql
                (
```
```sql
                    (rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.item_category IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
```
```sql
                    + (

                    )

                rr.rule_id

    FROM return_base b
```

answer:
Assuming the most-specific applicable rule sets the charge, I calculate it as the flat charge plus the rule’s percentage of product value. I use the year in `logtime` for the return year and the customer profile’s return count to apply the rule’s return-count bounds.

```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        json_extract_string(r.return_details, '$.reasoning.primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
        json_extract_string(q.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(c.return_behavior_profile, '$.total_returns')
            AS BIGINT
        ) AS customer_returns,
        p.unit_value
    FROM returns AS r
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment AS q
        ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE regexp_extract(r.logtime, '(19|20)[0-9]{2}', 0) = '2025'
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        rr.rule_id,
        COALESCE(rr.flat_charge, 0)
            + b.unit_value * COALESCE(rr.charge_pct, 0) / 100.0 AS handling_charge,
        (CASE WHEN rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            + (CASE WHEN rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            + (CASE WHEN rr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            + (CASE WHEN rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            + (CASE WHEN rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            + (CASE WHEN rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                      OR rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            AS specificity
    FROM base AS b
    JOIN return_charge_rules AS rr
        ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
       AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
       AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
       AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
       AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
       AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.customer_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
       AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.customer_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        casenum,
        handling_charge,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM matched_rules
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_returns
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
  AND handling_charge > 150;
```

```sql
WITH return_base AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
```
```sql
        c.seg_category,
```
```sql
        c.profilenum,
        r.revdate::DATE AS return_date,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        json_extract_string(r.return_details, '$.reasoning.primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
        json_extract_string(q.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.profilenum, date_trunc('month', r.revdate::DATE)
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns AS r
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products AS p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment AS q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        b.seg_category,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge + b.unit_value * rr.charge_pct / 100.0 AS return_handling_charge,
        (rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (rr.item_category IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INT
          + (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INT AS specificity
    FROM return_base AS b
    JOIN return_charge_rules AS rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
    WHERE b.return_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND b.return_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND b.seg_category IN ('Retail', 'Wholesale')
),
ranked_rules AS (

    FROM matched_rules
)
SELECT
    seg_category,
    ROUND(AVG(return_handling_charge), 2) AS avg_rhc
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
GROUP BY seg_category
ORDER BY seg_category;
```

        r.casenum,
```sql
        o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
        substring(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS return_month,
        count(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, substring(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS monthly_returns,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        json_extract_string(
            r.return_details, '$.reasoning.primary_reason'
        ) AS primary_reason,
        json_extract_string(
            q.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition'
        ) AS item_condition,
        p.unit_value
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                               OR rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                rr.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM return_base b
    JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR rr.min_monthly_returns <= b.monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR rr.max_monthly_returns >= b.monthly_returns)
),
chosen_rules AS (
    SELECT casenum, rule_id, flat_charge, charge_pct
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    b.return_month,
    round(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN cr.rule_id IS NULL
                THEN 15.00 + 5.0 / 100.0 * b.unit_value
            ELSE cr.flat_charge + cr.charge_pct / 100.0 * b.unit_value
        END
    ), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM return_base b
LEFT JOIN chosen_rules cr ON cr.casenum = b.casenum
WHERE b.customer_id = 'CUS00016'
  AND b.return_month LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY b.return_month
ORDER BY b.return_month;
```

```sql
WITH customer_month_returns AS (
```

```sql
    WHERE TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
```

```sql
    GROUP BY o.buyerlink, date_trunc('month', TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE))

            / 100.0 AS leakage_amount
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
    JOIN customer_month_returns cm

)

    100.0 * SUM(leakage_amount) FILTER (WHERE month_return_count >= 8)
    / SUM(leakage_amount),

) AS severe_share_pct
FROM leakage;
```

```sql
            ORDER BY
                (
```
```sql
                    CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
```
```sql
    FROM snapshot_tier s
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = s.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = s.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
),
chosen_rule AS (
    SELECT snapkey, rule_id, fixed_fee_usd, cover_pct
    FROM matching_rules
    WHERE rn = 1
),
settled AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        CASE
            WHEN cr.rule_id IS NULL
                THEN 300.0 + 0.05 * COALESCE(s.replcost, 0)
            ELSE cr.fixed_fee_usd
                 + (cr.cover_pct / 100.0) * COALESCE(s.replcost, 0)
        END AS settlement_amount,
        cr.rule_id
    FROM snapshot_tier s
    LEFT JOIN chosen_rule cr ON cr.snapkey = s.snapkey
    WHERE s.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND s.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN settlement_amount ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(settlement_amount), 0),
    2
) AS standard_share_pct
FROM settled;
```

```sql
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = b.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = b.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = b.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = b.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = b.vol_tier)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY snapkey
               ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
           ) AS rn
    FROM matches
),
settled AS (

           CASE WHEN r.rule_id IS NULL
                THEN 300.00 + 5.00 / 100.0 * COALESCE(b.replcost, 0.0)
                ELSE r.fixed_fee_usd + r.cover_pct / 100.0 * COALESCE(b.replcost, 0.0)
           END AS settlement_amount
    FROM prepared b
    LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.snapkey = b.snapkey AND r.rn = 1
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(settlement_amount) FILTER (WHERE rule_id IS NULL) AS standard_amount,
           SUM(settlement_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM settled
    WHERE snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
      AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * standard_amount / total_amount, 2) AS standard_share_pct
FROM totals;
```

```sql
                    + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                   w.rule_id
```

Using NULL rule fields as wildcards, capacity bands of **Small <100 MW**, **Mid 100–<300 MW**, and **Large ≥300 MW**, and selecting the most-specific applicable rule (lowest `rule_id` to break ties):

```sql
WITH snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        p.cap_mw,
        p.warrstate,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        om.replcost
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p
        ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm
        ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a
        ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om
        ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts <  TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS cap_band
    FROM snapshots
),
matches AS (
    SELECT
        c.snapkey,
        r.vol_tier,
        r.rule_id,
        COALESCE(r.fixed_fee_usd, 0)
            + c.replcost * r.cover_pct / 100.0 AS settlement_usd,
        (r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS specificity
    FROM categorized c
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = c.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = c.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = c.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = c.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = c.cap_band)
    WHERE r.vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY snapkey, vol_tier
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM matches
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_base AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pr.snapts,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        p.warrstate,
        p.cap_mw,
        a.alrtstate,
        om.replcost,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
        date_trunc('month', pr.snapts) AS snap_month
    FROM plant_record pr
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
),
volume AS (
    SELECT maker_group, snap_month, COUNT(*) AS monthly_volume
    FROM snapshot_base
    GROUP BY maker_group, snap_month
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT
        sb.*,
        CASE
            WHEN v.monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN v.monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshot_base sb
    JOIN volume v USING (maker_group, snap_month)
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapkey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT snapkey, rule_id, fixed_fee_usd, cover_pct
    FROM candidates
    WHERE rn = 1
),
settled AS (
    SELECT
        t.vol_tier,
        CASE WHEN g.rule_id IS NULL THEN 300.00 ELSE g.fixed_fee_usd END
        + (
            CASE WHEN g.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.00 ELSE g.cover_pct END / 100.0
          ) * COALESCE(t.replcost, 0) AS settlement_usd
    FROM tiered t
    LEFT JOIN governing g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey
    WHERE t.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND t.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM settled
WHERE vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY vol_tier
ORDER BY CASE vol_tier WHEN 'Bulk' THEN 1 WHEN 'Single' THEN 2 END;
```

                    (r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
                    (r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT snapkey, rule_id, fixed_fee_usd, cover_pct
    FROM candidates
    WHERE rn = 1
),
settled AS (
    SELECT
        t.vol_tier,
        CASE WHEN g.rule_id IS NULL THEN 300.00 ELSE g.fixed_fee_usd END
        + (
            CASE WHEN g.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.00 ELSE g.cover_pct END / 100.0
          ) * COALESCE(t.replcost, 0) AS settlement_usd
    FROM tiered t
    LEFT JOIN governing g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey
    WHERE t.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND t.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM settled
WHERE vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY vol_tier
ORDER BY CASE vol_tier WHEN 'Bulk' THEN 1 WHEN 'Single' THEN 2 END;

The settlement average uses the governing matching rule for each snapshot, with standard terms applied when no rule matches. Claim volume tiers are calculated across all snapshots for the same manufacturer group and calendar month.

```sql
WITH snapshot_base AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pr.snapts,
        COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        COALESCE(om.replcost, 0.0) AS replcost
    FROM plant_record pr
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', snapts), maker_group
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM snapshot_base
),
valued AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM tiered
),
matches AS (
    SELECT
        v.snapkey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        (r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS specificity
    FROM valued v
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = v.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = v.pnlkind)
     AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = v.alrtstate)
     AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = v.warrstate)
     AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = v.cap_band)
     AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = v.vol_tier)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY snapkey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM matches
),
settlements AS (
    SELECT
        v.snapkey,
        v.snapts,
        v.vol_tier,
        COALESCE(r.fixed_fee_usd, 300.0)
            + COALESCE(r.cover_pct, 5.0) / 100.0 * v.replcost
            AS settlement_usd
    FROM valued v
    LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.snapkey = v.snapkey AND r.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM settlements
WHERE snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
  AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
  AND vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY vol_tier
ORDER BY CASE vol_tier WHEN 'Bulk' THEN 1 WHEN 'Single' THEN 2 END;
```

```sql
WITH per_snapshot AS (
    SELECT strftime(pr.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,
           TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.power.power_now_w') AS DOUBLE) AS power_now_w,
           TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.power.power_loss_w') AS DOUBLE) AS power_loss_w
    FROM plant_record AS pr
    JOIN plants AS p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN electrical_performance AS ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pm.pnlkind = 'HJT'
      AND pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01'
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT month,

           SUM(CASE WHEN power_now_w IS NOT NULL AND power_loss_w IS NOT NULL THEN power_loss_w END) AS power_loss_w
    FROM per_snapshot
    GROUP BY month
),
ratios AS (

           ROUND(100.0 * power_loss_w / NULLIF(power_now_w + power_loss_w, 0), 2) AS loss_ratio_pct

FROM ratios
ORDER BY month;
```

Assuming “recoverable” loss means energy yield multiplied by the soiling-loss percentage, and the Low/Severe bands are the bottom/top quartiles of technology-month average loss, the results are:

| loss_band | snapshots | avg_loss_kwh |
|---|---:|---:|

| Severe | 25 | 138.22 |

```sql
WITH snapshot_losses AS (
    SELECT
        r.snapkey,
        p.pnlkind AS technology,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.snapts)::INTEGER AS month_num,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(e.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) * TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(e.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) / 100.0 AS loss_kwh
    FROM plant_record AS r
    JOIN plants AS s
        ON s.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS p
        ON p.modkey = s.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance AS e
        ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
tech_month AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        month_num,
        AVG(loss_kwh) AS month_avg_loss_kwh
    FROM snapshot_losses
    WHERE loss_kwh IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY technology, month_num
),
bands AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        month_num,
        CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY month_avg_loss_kwh)
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Severe'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM tech_month
)
SELECT
    b.loss_band,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(sl.loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM snapshot_losses AS sl
JOIN bands AS b
    USING (technology, month_num)
WHERE b.loss_band IN ('Low', 'Severe')
GROUP BY b.loss_band
ORDER BY CASE b.loss_band WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Severe' THEN 2 END;
```
